summary: Short narrow kerb beside apartments with a no-stopping sign and steep grade.
reasons: No Stopping signs on this stretch

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks line the west side, 9-11 m from the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane with no verge; stretch is shorter than a van and kerb-to-building.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end style street, but residents drive through.
drivers.convention: No Stopping 7-9am Mon-Fri and No Stopping Any Time signs nearby; no cars parked.

flags: Signs: No Stopping Any Time and 7-9am Mon-Fri
sun_shade: Trees on the east side shade the lane; buildings shade the west.
